text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy pulls ahead of the<n>pack! A dauntless
warrior worthy of<n>the dirt crown has just emerged
right<n>here at Tokyo Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoa! I never knew she had that inher! That last burst of speed wascrazy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The stands are abuzz with excitement<n>following an
unexpectedly heated<n>race!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff! I won. I WON!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What a spectacular race! The crowd<n>is awash with
delight! Who said this<n>race had no big contender?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh... Heh heh... Heeheehee!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gyaaahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Sh-Shinko Windy has burst out into<n>laughter! She's
letting out a raucous<n>cackle!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: OHHH YEEEEEAH!<n>GRRRAAAWRRRRR!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! Didja see that?! That's<n>the true power
of Wiiicked Windyyy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Aren't your minds blown?! Look at<n>me! Be in awe!
Wahaha! I'm the<n>greatest Umamusume there is!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Haha, she's overdoing it a bit with<n>the boasting...
But wow, that was an<n>incredible performance!
Congrats on<n>your victory!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Everyone teased her for being a biter,<n>so I figured
that's all she was. But it<n>turns out, she's got some
real skills!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text: E-exactly! She's special. Windy is so<n>awesome!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It couldn't be clearer that people's<n>opinions on
Shinko Windy have<n>changed!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha! Listen to all those cheers!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! This is where the winner<n>stands! Get
outta here! Shoo, shoo!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't get all worked up! Let me<n>congratulate
you at least!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it really stings that you beat me...<n>But it was a
great race!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Congrats on coming first, Windy.<n>You're really
amazing... And super<n>strong!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh heh! Hehe, hehehe... You're not<n>bad, either!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
C'mon. Anyone who's gonna be<n>Windy's rival
has gotta be pretty<n>good herself.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
D-does that mean you've accepted<n>me as your
rival?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I changed my mind is all.<n>Decided I could
give you this.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: W-woooow! Thanks, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Didja see that, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Of course! You both ran well!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hehe! We pulled out all the stops!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And Windy! You really did it! Now<n>everyone knows
how good you are,<n>and things will start to change!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: They better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy nods in agreement.<n>Looks like she
also felt the difference<n>in the crowd's response
today.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Windy... Compared to me and<n>the other
runners, you've had it really<n>rough, right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... Yeah, but I guess I deserved<n>it.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you never gave up. You<n>stayed strong all
the way.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Not just anyone is capable of that.<n>Most would
have thrown in the towel<n>by now.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yet you didn't waver. I think...<n>watching you has
taught me a very<n>valuable lesson.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And it's that no matter how tough<n>things might get,
you should never<n>give up on trying again!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So I won't quit either—no matter how<n>badly I'm
beaten!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: After all, a true hero always gets back<n>up!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Don't give up, and maybe one<n>day... way,
waaay in the future you'll<n>eventually beat me.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ngh! You won't be waiting that long!When's our next race? I'm winningthat one for sure!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh! Bring it on! Let's see ya back<n>those words
up!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: No problem! I'll prove it to you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, I win! ♪ I win, I win, I win! ♪<n>Victory tastes
sooo sweeeeet! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Let's keep it up and win the<n>next one, too!
choice_data_list: Right! We should decide on your next race.
Right! We should decide on your next race.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I wanna take on another G1! A reaaal<n>big one!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll win again and make those jerks<n>who still don't
recognize my skill go,<n>"Whoa! She's the real deal!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the positive reaction at the<n>racecourse, not
everyone<n>acknowledges Windy's strength yet.<n>She
wants to make them eat their<n>words!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And I feel the same. I want to put her<n>true skill on
display in another G1<n>race!
choice_data_list: Let's take on the Teio Sho.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The Teio Sho, huh? Nice choice, my<n>diabolical
strategist!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Now with that decided, you<n>better get to work
on whippin' up a<n>special training regimen for
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next objective is the Teio Sho!<n>We need to
keep flaunting Shinko<n>Windy's true strength to the
world!
